content.text: carbamazepine may stim vasopressin release but = inferior to DDAVP, so seldom used

Boxed: serious & sometimes fatal dermatologic rxns incl TEN & SJS reported during tx; est 1 to 6 per 10,000 new users in mainly Caucasian pop, ~10x higher in some Asian countries. Boxed: screen pts w ancestry in genetically at-risk pop for HLA-B*1502 b4 starting; pts testing (+) should ⍉ be treated unless the benefit clearly outweighs the risk. Boxed: aplastic anemia & agranulocytosis reported; risk 5 to 8 × > in the gen pop. Boxed: obtain complete pretreatment hematological testing as a baseline; monitor closely if WBC or PLT counts are ↓/↓; consider discontinuing if sig bone marrow depression develops. CI: Hx of prev bone marrow depression · hypersensitivity to the drug or known sensitivity to any tricyclic compounds. CI: coadministration w nefazodone. DRESS/multiorgan hypersensitivity occurred, some fatal; if such signs/Sx are present, evaluate STAT & d/c if an alt Eti cannot be established. AEDs incl Tegretol ↑risk of suicidal thoughts or behavior; monitor for emergence or worsening of depression · suicidal thoughts or behavior and/or unusual chgs in mood or behavior. Hyponatremia (often SIADH) can occur; risk appears dose-related; elderly pts & pts on diuretics are @ greater risk. Rare anaphylaxis & angioedema (larynx · glottis · lips · eyelids) reported; angioedema w laryngeal edema can be fatal; d/c & start alt tx; ⍉ rechallenge. May render hormonal contraceptives less effective; breakthrough bleed & unintended pregnancies reported; consider alt or back-up contraception. Coadministration w rivaroxaban · apixaban · dabigatran and edoxaban should be avoided (↓ anticoag plasma concentrations). OD: first signs/Sx appear after 1 to 3 h; neuromusc disturb most prominent; severe ♡ comp occur only @ very ↑doses (> 60 g). OD tx: prompt elim of the drug = critical; induce vomiting · irrigate the stomach and take steps to diminish absorb
